items.name: 01-hero
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, realistic proportions, no people, no text, no logos, no readable labels. A neatly organised fitted wardrobe in a British bedroom with both white shaker doors open: clothes on matching slim wooden hangers grouped by type and colour on a hanging rail, a lower double-hanging section with shirts and folded trousers, folded jumpers in neat stacks on shelves with clear acrylic shelf dividers, two fabric storage boxes on the top shelf, a row of shoes on a low shelf. Soft daylight, calm and tidy.

items.name: 02-double-rail
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, realistic proportions, no people, no text, no logos. Close view inside a wardrobe with two hanging rails one above the other (double hanging): shirts and blouses on the top rail, trousers folded over hangers and skirts on the bottom rail, all on matching slim velvet hangers facing the same way, sorted by colour. Even soft light.

items.name: 03-file-fold
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, realistic proportions, no people, no text, no logos. Top-down view of an open wardrobe drawer with T-shirts and jumpers file-folded and standing upright in rows so every item is visible, separated by fabric drawer dividers, in soft neutral colours. Natural light.

items.name: 05-seasonal
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, realistic proportions, no people, no text, no logos, no readable labels. items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, vertical composition, realistic proportions, no people, no text, no logos, no readable labels.
